uploadPolicy.title: Upload Policy
uploadPolicy.subtitle: Please read the following rules before uploading your charts.
uploadPolicy.everyChartHint: These apply to every chart, whether it's public, unlisted or private.
uploadPolicy.noOfficialCharts: No official charts from any rhythm game, unless specifically allowed by the game developers
uploadPolicy.publicHint: Public charts are shown to other users. There are additional rules you must follow.
uploadPolicy.noWip: No incomplete, WIP, or test charts
uploadPolicy.previewRequired: Public charts need a music preview. We recommend 30 seconds with the last 2 seconds "fading out".
uploadPolicy.fileTypesNote: Note: Extreme extended features can only be found in LevelData! You can open .usc in the editor to continue working.
uploadPolicy.noInappropriate: No slurs, racism, politics, heavily inappropriate things, advertising, etc.
uploadPolicy.noAbuse: Do not abuse our services for the sake of abusing them
uploadPolicy.correctMetadata: Your metadata must be correct (including jackets)
